g.text: AXLE, BEARINGS AND OUTBOARD BRAKE SUPPORT
C5 R0 · 19 OCT 2026 · MILLIMETRES UNLESS MARKED · PRELIMINARY — NOT FOR FABRICATION
Exact CAD edges, cropped at Y400. Box/frame bearings and outboard axle-riding carrier remain separate.
Ø90 to 1060; Ø80 seats; housing Ø180
Remove hub, covers, nut, bearing stack outward
BRAKE INTERFACE: DEFINED PHYSICS / OPEN OEM FIT
Carrier plate Ø280 and a 200 mm torque arm connect through a 500 mm articulated link to
the transverse frame box. Two axle-mounted carrier bearings keep the spider support
Reserved drum envelope: |Y|1080..1290 and OD ≤420. D1 friction ID311.15 / width 101.6
are verified; drum OD, pilot, PCD, spider holes, chamber brackets and hub torque
Drum reservation is not an OEM model. No brake torque, stopping distance or working-brake claim follows from the visible carrier/hub blanks.
At 6 kNm sensitivity the 200 mm arm produces about 30 kN link reaction; axle overhang, rotating fatigue, joint notches and braking/twist interaction remain open.
Catalogue bearing C/C0 values are not application acceptance. Carrier minimum-load/skidding, lubrication, axial accommodation and heat require review.
Wheel blank and axle fits require wheel/rail profile, steel/heat-treatment/NDT, interference, pressing, fatigue and inspection specifications.
